questions.q: Which tense: 'She has been working here for years.'
questions.why: *has been working* = *have / has been* + *-ing* — Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.q: Which tense: 'I was sleeping when he called.'
questions.why: *was sleeping* = *was / were* + *-ing* — Past Continuous. Past Simple — *slept*; Past Perfect — *had slept*; Present Continuous — *am sleeping*; *was sleeping* — лише Past Continuous.

questions.q: Which tense: 'By June we will have moved.'
questions.why: *will have moved* = *will have* + третя форма — Future Perfect. Future Simple — *will move*; Future Continuous — *will be moving*; Present Perfect — *have moved*; *will have* + V3 — Future Perfect.

questions.q: Present Perfect: 'I ___ (live) here since 2015.'
questions.why: Present Perfect: *have lived* (або Continuous *have been living*).

questions.q: Future Continuous: 'At 9 tomorrow she ___ (work).'
questions.why: Future Continuous: *will be working*.

questions.q: The formula "had + V3" is:
questions.why: *had* + третя форма — Past Perfect. Present Perfect — *have / has* + V3; Past Simple — V2; Future Perfect — *will have* + V3.

questions.q: Which tense describes a habit?
questions.why: Звички й регулярні дії — Present Simple. Present Continuous — дія зараз; Past Perfect і Future Perfect — дія до моменту в минулому чи майбутньому.

questions.q: Which tense: 'They had been waiting for two hours.'
questions.why: *had been waiting* — Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.q: Future Perfect: 'She ___ (finish) the report by 5 pm.'
questions.why: Future Perfect: *will have finished*.

answer: I have been waiting for an hour
questions.why: *have been waiting* — Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.q: I ___ (work) here since 2020.
questions.why: *since 2020* — Present Perfect (Simple чи Continuous).

questions.q: Yesterday at 6 pm I ___ (drive) home.
questions.why: Процес у конкретний момент минулого — *was driving*.

questions.q: By the time she arrived, we ___ (finish).
questions.why: Раніше за інший момент у минулому — *had finished*.

questions.q: Look! It ___ (snow).
questions.why: *Look!* — дія саме зараз: *is snowing*.

questions.q: I ___ (see) him last week.
questions.why: *last week* — Past Simple: *saw*.

questions.q: Next year I ___ (be) 30.
questions.why: Факт про майбутнє (вік) — *will be*.

questions.q: She ___ to work by bus every day.
questions.why: *every day* — звичка, Present Simple. *is going* — дія зараз або план; *has gone* — результат; *went every* — дає *every every day* і минулий час.

questions.q: We ___ for two hours when the bus finally came.
questions.why: Тривалість до моменту в минулому — *had been waiting*. *have waited* — Present Perfect, а відлік у минулому; *were waited* — пасив; *are waiting* — теперішній час.

questions.q: This time tomorrow I ___ on the beach.
questions.why: *This time tomorrow* — Future Continuous. *will lie* — разова дія, а не процес у той момент; *lie* — теперішній час; *am lying on* — зайвий прийменник.

answer: I have never been to Spain
questions.why: Досвід за життя — Present Perfect: *I have never been…*
questions.hint: Я ніколи не був в Іспанії.

answer: She was reading when I came in
When I came in she was reading
questions.why: Процес (*was reading*) перервала подія (*came in*).

answer: They will have finished by Monday
By Monday they will have finished
questions.why: *by Monday* — Future Perfect: *will have finished*.

questions.q: This time next week I ___ on a beach.
questions.why: Процес у момент майбутнього — *will be lying*. *will lie* — разова дія; *will have lain* — дія, завершена до того моменту; *am lying* — зараз, а не через тиждень.

questions.q: She ___ here since 2018.
questions.why: *since 2018* — Present Perfect: *has worked*.

questions.q: When I arrived, the train ___ (already / leave).
questions.why: *already* відносно моменту в минулому — *had already left*.
